facts.label: Discurso indireto com said e told
facts.sub: Para contar o que alguém disse, use said (that) ou told me (that) + verbo no passado: She said that the client was coming. She told me that the report was not ready.

facts.label: Disse
facts.sub: Use said + frase para contar o que alguém disse: She said that the client was coming. O verbo da frase volta um tempo: is vira was, am vira was, have to vira had to. That pode ser omitido.

facts.label: Disse a
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told me that the report was ready. Depois de told, sempre vem me, us, him, her, them. Sem a pessoa, use said. Não diga told that.

compare.ask: She told me that the report was not ready.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Ela disse que o cliente vinha”, e o verbo muda de forma.

compare.us: Em inglês: said/told me + that + passado: She said that the client was coming.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: In reported speech, we often use the past.
We say “She told that the report was ready.”
items.why: We say She told me that… or She said that…

items.s: “She said she was sorry” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: In reported speech, we often use the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes: is becomes was.)
We say “She told that the report was ready.” → Falso (We say She told me that… or She said that…)
“She said she was sorry” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a busy office in Ottawa. Snow falls outside the big windows. Carl is drinking coffee at his desk. His boss sent a message at eight o’clock. Clara walks in and puts her bag down. Carl wants to tell her what the boss said.
“Clara, did you see the message from our boss this morning?” says Carl. “Not yet. What did she say in it?” says Clara. “She said that the client was coming at ten.” says Carl.
